firstPlayerRule: During the day phase, any player may take the first turn. Continue one at a time in any order; a player may take several turns in a row.
clarifications: On a turn, perform one action or pass. A player who passes cannot take more actions that day; continue until everyone has passed.
Groups may choose simultaneous day turns. Resolve conflicting effects using the group’s chosen conflict-resolution system.
Multi-character solo controls two or more characters. Hardcore solo controls one character and an animal companion, with a separate continuation procedure after that character perishes.
Resolve effects that occur at the start of the day before taking day actions. The Dawn Rule and optional Dusk Rule resolve uncertainty about conflicting effects and timing.
